title: Signal: Possible hardcoded password assignment in source
limitations: Shape-only: a quoted assignment that cannot prove a live credential. Only denylisted substrings (EXAMPLE, changeme) are vetoed. Angle-bracket and env-reference placeholders such as <password> or ${DB_PASSWORD} are NOT vetoed and still match (known false positive; denylist tuning is an owner decision).
